note: Measured by tools/clip_provenance.py during a full canonical run. 'moves', the counts and the displacements are measured; 'what', 'reaches_output', 'resolution_declared' and 'test' are reviewed judgements. A clip that moves a value produced a number the method could not produce inside the physical range.

qta_multiphysics/campaign_uncertainty_3d.what: Sampled sticking coefficient bounded into its physical range. An input bound, as above.

qta_multiphysics/gas_transport_1d.py:rhs.resolution_declared: indirectly, through the solve it sits in: GasTransport1DResult.resolution_floor_1m3, stated per species in gas_transport_metrics.csv and per cell in gas_transport_profile.csv
qta_multiphysics/gas_transport_1d.py:rhs.what: Positivity of the integrator's TRIAL states, inside the ODE right-hand side. It changes the equation BDF is solving rather than the array that is written, so it shapes the reported profile without ever being a reported value. Its displacement reaches 1.53e+03, above this solve's own atol of 1e3, which says the trial iterates go meaningfully negative during the Mode-B transient and not merely at the noise floor -- worth knowing, and not by itself a defect in a stiff transport problem with strong local sinks.

qta_multiphysics/gas_transport_1d.py:sol.resolution_declared: resolution_{species}_modeC in gas_transport_profile.csv; residual_mode_D_resolution, resolution_floor_1m3 and cells_below_resolution_modeC in gas_transport_metrics.csv; Mode_D_residual_*_resolution and gas_resolution_floor_1m3 in the coupled metrics
qta_multiphysics/gas_transport_1d.py:sol.what: The positivity clip on the integrator's RETURNED solution. This is the one that writes numbers. In Mode C it turns methane's noise -- negative in all 120 cells, -1.8e-10 to -1.9e+01, entirely inside this solve's atol of 1e3 -- into exact zeros, which %.9e then states to ten significant figures. D-2026-53.

qta_multiphysics/material_models.py:inte.what: Interpolation argument bounded to the tabulated range [0, Tmax]. A bound on a lookup, not on a solution.

qta_multiphysics/surface_coverage.py:evo.resolution_declared: COVERAGE_ATOL, stated as resolution_floor_theta in surface_coverage_metrics.csv and per cell as resolution_{species}_modeC in the profile
qta_multiphysics/surface_coverage.py:evo.what: Fractional coverage clipped into [0,1] on the returned solution. Observed to move nothing across a full canonical run; the smallest serialised coverage is 7.6e-11, some 76x the solve's atol.

qta_multiphysics/surface_coverage.py:rhs.what: Trial coverages clipped into [0,1] inside the right-hand side.

qta_multiphysics/thermal_1d.py:rhs.what: Temperature floored at 1e-6 K inside the right-hand side, so the power-law conductivity is never evaluated at or below zero.

qta_multiphysics/thermal_2d_axisymmetric.what: Temperature floored at 1e-6 K inside the right-hand side.
Surface temperature floored at 1e-6 K before the conductivity evaluation that produces the reported k_out.

qta_multiphysics/thermal_3d_transient.py.what: Temperature floored at 1e-6 K inside the 3D right-hand side.

qta_multiphysics/uncertainty.py:run_mont.what: Sampled parameters bounded into their physical ranges (absorbed fraction, conductivity exponent, sticking). Bounds on INPUTS drawn from assumed distributions, not on any solve's output.
